s.n: Keith's tea and brown butter shortbread
s.note: the stranger in the rental makes her tea
s.how: Melt 200g butter and cook until it smells nutty and goes golden brown, then chill until firm but soft. Beat with 90g caster sugar until pale, then mix in 250g plain flour, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20cm square tin, sprinkle with demerara and flaky salt, prick all over and bake at 160C for 35 minutes. Cut into fingers while warm. Brew a pot of black tea for 4 minutes and serve alongside.

s.n: Rental kitchen salami and cheddar toasties
s.note: whatever's in a short-stay rental kitchen
s.how: Butter one side of 8 slices of sourdough. On the unbuttered side of 4 slices, layer 50g grated sharp cheddar, 4 slices salami and a few sliced pickles, then more cheese, and top with the remaining bread, buttered side out. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted. Cut into fingers and serve with hot English mustard.

m.how: Press 600g pizza dough into an oiled rectangular tin and prove 30 minutes. Cover right to the edges with 200g cubed mozzarella and 150g cheddar, add 100g pepperoni and bake at 250C for 15 minutes. Stripe tomato sauce simmered with garlic on top.

w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in 250ml boiling water with 1 tsp bicarb. Beat 80g butter with 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour and the dates. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Pour over sauce of 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 200ml cream.

d.note: a glass to settle the nerves on that first awkward night
d.how: In a large jug, combine a 750ml bottle of medium-bodied red, 60ml brandy, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 sliced orange, 1 diced apple and 1 cinnamon stick. Stir to dissolve the sugar and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 300ml lemonade. Pour into glasses with some of the fruit in each.
